description: This file contains tests for channel status output, particularly handling runtime errors for signal and iMessage channels, utilizing Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: collectStatusIssues
methods.description: Collects status issues for the 'signal' plugin account, wrapping collectStatusIssuesFromLastError.

methods.name: setActivePluginRegistry
methods.description: Sets the active plugin registry for testing, called before and after each test.

methods.name: createChannelTestPluginBase
methods.description: Creates a base plugin object for testing channels, used here for the 'signal' plugin.

methods.name: createTestRegistry
methods.description: Creates a test plugin registry with listed plugins.

methods.name: formatGatewayChannelsStatusLines
methods.description: Formats the status lines for gateway channels, used in assertions for runtime error output.
